title: No-show without a qualifying documented disruption
facts_text: I had a reservation beginning on 20 October but I did not arrive before the 03:00 no-show cutoff. There was no documented flight cancellation or other verified travel disruption. I arrived late because of a personal delay.
request: Can you reinstate the remaining stay or provide a refund for the unused nights?

strict.reason: The guest did not arrive before the 03:00 cutoff, so the booking is treated as a no-show under the strict policy.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: There is no documented cancellation of the guest's scheduled inbound flight, so the experimental exception does not apply.
exception.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

ambiguous.reason: The ambiguous policy permits consideration of exceptional circumstances without defining the criteria, so the decision is discretionary.
ambiguous.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

review_notes: Paired with easyhotel_007_noshow_verified_flight_cancellation. This scenario does not satisfy the researcher-created no-show exception.
